Match this project's collection of richly detailed realistic painted character cutouts, with tactile aged steel, leather, heraldic cloth, natural anatomy and restrained dramatic lighting. Subject: a disciplined pale vampire knight of the Blood Dragon order, in ornate blackened late-medieval Gothic plate with dark crimson enamel and worn antique brass trim, seated on a living black warhorse with armored barding and deep crimson caparison. His raised visor reveals a stern mature pale face; he carries a long straight sword angled down and a heater shield with a simple black drake emblem on crimson. A crimson standard bearing the same black winged drake rises behind his shoulder, no lettering. Beside and behind the horse, a living blood wyrm crouches protectively: charcoal-black reptilian scales, horned dragon head, powerful limbs, leathery dark crimson wing membranes, folded wings forming a compact arch, tail curling into the composition. It is alive, intact, not skeletal, not rotting, no exposed bones, no fire breath. The knight and warhorse remain the clear foreground focus; the wyrm is a secondary guardian. A few small bats above evoke the order's mountain keep. Small irregular patch of broken mountain stone under their feet; minimal cold grey mist dissolving at the base. Chivalric resolve and supernatural menace. Muted black steel, oxblood crimson, cold ivory and antique brass, realistic hand-painted fantasy book illustration, not a miniature photograph, not a toy or 3D render. Square canvas, centered compact triangular composition, full figures, all hooves, wings, banner and weapons completely inside frame, generous clear margin on all four sides. CRITICAL: genuine transparent PNG alpha background around artwork and between silhouette gaps; preserve transparency. NO rectangular scenery, castle panorama, sky, white or black backdrop, painted checkerboard, parchment, text, title, lettering, logos, border or watermark. No graphic gore.

Subject: a dramatic compact battle between an Empire human general and a towering Chaos warrior. An ancient winged dragon arcs high above the clash, its complete wings folded into a compact arch, representing the magical world and broad scope of fantasy battles. Small irregular patch of broken stone and battlefield debris beneath. Strong diagonal movement and balanced triangular composition, restrained blue, red, gold and iron palette. Square canvas. CRITICAL: actual transparent PNG alpha background around the entire artwork and between silhouette gaps. NO rectangular scenery, sky, black backdrop, white backdrop, painted checkerboard or parchment. Sparse smoke dissolves into transparency. Leave generous clear transparent margin on all four sides, contain ALL wings, weapons and figures, no cropping. NO text, title, words, letters, logos, border, watermark.
